decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the About-page reward-collection copy from automatic prize payout to a conditional claim button and updates the related feature summary.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates all FAQ attributes that describe prize collection to require the conditional claim button while preserving automatic commissions.
The existing same-message MODIFY and RESUME fully record manual prize collection through a claim button shown only when the prize is claimable; no additional attribute cleanup is required.
Changing how a selected winner collects a prize does not alter winner eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or the on-chain selection method.
The conditional prize-claim decision does not necessarily change the landing-page hero copy or layout currently required.
The source decision does not change whether winner notifications or fiat cashout guidance are emailed; claiming a prize into fiat is distinct from the on-site prize claim button.
Fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, wallet ownership of prizes, dashboard access, and cashout guidance remain valid regardless of whether the prize first requires a conditional on-site claim.
Prize collection behavior is unrelated to the landing-page book-cover size, crop, placement, overlap, and visibility rules.
The prize-claim interaction does not change badge eligibility, storage, approved badge set, or current badge effects.
The source decision does not alter the contract-upgrade strategy or treatment of legacy contract data.
A conditional prize claim button does not change the required NFT referral, ticket, commission, badge, or metadata-accounting attributes.
Changing prize collection from automatic transfer to manual claim does not alter the $15 primary-mint allocation among founder, affiliate, and Small Block prize pool.
